decision: Playwright is evidence, not the template
reason: Removes the element through its handle, then expects the scroll to throw 'Element is not attached to the DOM' at once. Strider has no handle bound to one node: a locator finds its match again on each attempt, so the scroll would wait for a new match rather than throw
An element with display: contents and only text has no box, so it is never visible, never scrollable, and has no action point
Differs, pending a decision: focus and scrollIntoView wait for the element to be visible where Playwright's do not
